headline: Management maintained stable volume and margin guidance across quarters, delivering within or close to targeted ranges despite fluctuating quarterly results.

promises.promise: Volume growth in the 8 to 10 percent band for Q4.
promises.quote: I think as we go ahead, this band would remain, in terms of what we would be able to target for the Q4 as well.
promises.evidence: Decorative business achieved 12.4% volume growth and coatings volume reached 12.7% in the quarter.
promises.evidence_quote: When we look at the decorative business, we have achieved 12.4% volume growth and a very strong value growth of 10.2%.

promises.promise: Endeavour to maintain margin guidance between 18 and 20%
promises.quote: So, I would say that we would keep the guidance between that 18 and 20% band as we go ahead and that is something which we will endeavour to maintain.
promises.evidence: H1 PBDIT margin was in the higher range at 19.6%.
promises.evidence_quote: The great thing to look at is that the PBDIT margin growth at a half-year level is very good and the PBDIT margin is in the higher range of the overall band of what we have been speaking at 19.6%.

promises.promise: Train almost 10 lakh people this year.
promises.quote: This year, as we kind of go ahead, we are gunning for training almost 10 lakh people.
promises.evidence: Management did not report or mention the training count figure in subsequent calls.

promises.promise: High single-digit volume growth of 8-10% going forward.
promises.quote: We are still confident that demand conditions should continue giving us closer to high single-digit volume growth in the band of about 8 -10%, as we predict going forward.
promises.evidence: Overall volume growth was strong at about 9% in Q1 FY27.
promises.evidence_quote: Overall, we are at about a strong 9% volume growth.

promises.promise: Commission first phase of VAM-VAE in H1 FY27
promises.quote: we expect to commission first phase in the first half of this year.
promises.evidence: Management discussed capacity utilization plans for the VAE plant in Q2 FY27 call without confirming commissioning date.

shifts.change: Adjusted the realistic gap expectation from 4-5% down to 3-4%.
